name: Sonos_Panel
description: Sonos Panel - a self-hosted touchscreen web app for controlling a whole-house Sonos system. Point any number of cheap tablets at it and use them as wall-mounted control panels around the house. Everything is local: no cloud, no account, no internet dependency. Features: every room with grouping (the room you tap becomes the group head, like the official app), play/pause/skip/seek, per-room and group volume, EQ, sleep timers, shuffle/repeat/crossfade, full queue management with drag-to-reorder, Sonos playlists and favorites (organized by service AND by account, so multi-login households don't interrupt each other), line-in sources, an ambient screensaver, and up to 3 extra tabs embedding other local dashboards such as Home Assistant or Hubitat. Network Music Library: point the optional Music Path at a folder of music files and the panel indexes them and streams them straight to your speakers - with no Sonos 65,000-song index limit. Browse by Artists, Albums, Songs, Genres, Composers, Folders, or Recently Added, with unified search and self-healing album art. Optional 4-digit passcode locks structural changes (deleting or renaming playlists, editing groups) behind an onscreen keypad while leaving playback and queue control open for guests. Supports BOTH Sonos S1 and S2 systems - set the Sonos System field to s1 or s2. One container controls one generation (S1 and S2 are separate Sonos households that cannot mix); to control both, install this container twice with different IPs and appdata paths. IMPORTANT - this container needs a fixed IP on a custom Docker network (br0) for Sonos SSDP discovery and for speakers to stream local music back from the panel. Bridge networking will not work. Setup: 1. Settings - Docker - Network Types: set br0 to ipvlan mode (highly recommended for Sonos). 2. Set Network Type to br0 on this container. 3. Set Fixed IP Address to a free IP on your LAN (outside your router's DHCP range). 4. Apply, then open http://the-ip-you-chose/ - no port number needed.

paths.name: Music Path
paths.description: Optional. Folder on this server containing your music files (e.g. /mnt/user/Media/Music). Enables the Local Music Library -- the panel streams these files straight to the speakers, with no Sonos 65,000-song index limit. Read-only: the panel never modifies your files. Music on a different machine? Mount it on the Unraid HOST first (Unassigned Devices plugin -> /mnt/remotes/...) and point this field there -- do not enter a \\server\share path, Windows-style UNC paths do not work inside the container.

variables.name: Public Base URL
variables.description: Optional. The URL the SPEAKERS use to fetch music from the panel, e.g. http://10.1.10.25 -- only used by the Local Music Library. Leave blank to auto-detect, which works correctly on br0/ipvlan (this template's setup) and host networking. Only set this if speakers fail to play local files.

variables.name: Rescan Schedule
variables.description: Optional, Local Music Library only. When to automatically rescan the music folder: daily@HH:MM (e.g. daily@03:30) or weekly@DAY@HH:MM (e.g. weekly@sun@04:00, days mon-sun). Times use the TZ setting below. Leave blank for no scheduled rescans -- a rescan ALWAYS runs at container start regardless, and unchanged files are skipped, so startup scans are quick once the library is indexed.

variables.name: TZ
variables.description: Timezone for the Rescan Schedule times (IANA name, e.g. America/Denver, America/New_York, Europe/London). Only matters if Rescan Schedule is set.

variables.name: Application Port
variables.description: Internal port the app listens on. Leave at 80 to match the WebUI link, which assumes no port number is needed.

variables.name: Sonos System (s1 or s2)
variables.description: Which Sonos generation this container controls: s2 (current, default) or s1 (legacy 11.x systems). One container = one generation -- S1 and S2 are separate households that cannot mix. To control both, install this container twice with different fixed IPs and appdata paths, one per system. Also adjusts the Local Music Library's codec limits (S1 caps lossless at 16-bit; S2 allows 24-bit FLAC/ALAC).

variables.name: Passcode
variables.description: Optional. A 4-digit code that locks down structural changes on the panel: deleting or renaming playlists, editing account names, adding tracks to playlists, and any group add/edit/apply. Playback and queue control stay open. After a correct entry the panel stays unlocked while in use; 60 seconds without any touch locks it again. Leave blank to disable the lock entirely.

variables.name: Screensaver Timeout (seconds)
variables.description: Seconds of no touch/click before the screensaver activates.

variables.name: Tab 2 Title
variables.description: Optional second tab. Name shown on the tab -- leave everything in this group blank to not show a second tab.

variables.name: Tab 2 Color
variables.description: Optional second tab. Hex color for this tab's underline -- falls back to the app's default accent color if left blank.

variables.name: Tab 2 Icon
variables.description: Optional second tab. Icon shown at the start of the tab -- an emoji (e.g. house) or a full image URL both work. Leave blank for no icon.

variables.name: Tab 2 URL
variables.description: Optional second tab. Full URL of the site/dashboard to embed (e.g. a Hubitat or Home Assistant dashboard). This tab only appears if this is set.

variables.name: Tab 3 Title
variables.description: Optional third tab. Name shown on the tab.
